market_read: Week 4 snapshot: 18 verified rows, 0 indicative. All 18 rows retained identical asking prices for the third consecutive week with zero delisted URLs, making this the most static four-week window on record and confirming a seller-controlled market with no visible negotiation pressure. Verified range holds at PHP 269–3,000/sqm; dataset median unchanged at PHP 1,200/sqm. Pagsanjan-core median (8 rows) remains PHP 975/sqm versus ring median (10 rows) PHP 1,600/sqm — both figures unrevised since the baseline run and still attributable to the large 5+ ha parcels in the core pulling the core median down rather than any genuine location discount. No listing has cleared publicly in four weeks, so no confirmed price-clearing signal exists. For a raw 0.5–1 ha Pagsanjan parcel, the tightest comparables remain Maulawin (4,767 sqm, PHP 2,000/sqm) and Bulilan Norte/Pila (6,447 sqm, PHP 2,000/sqm), supporting an asking range of PHP 1,600–2,000/sqm; PHP 1,400/sqm remains the fastest-sale recommendation, unchanged from baseline.
